newsitem.title: ITALY: Police find Mafia boss's hidden treasure.
newsitem.headline: Police find Mafia boss's hidden treasure.

text.p: Police have found a treasure of gold ingots, diamonds and jewels believed to have been stashed away by Salvatore Toto Riina, the Mafia "boss of bosses" arrested in 1993, Italian radio reported on Friday.
The report said the treasure, worth at least $1.3 million, was hidden in an apartment owned by a Riina lieutenant near the western Sicilian city of Trapani.
The valuables, concealed under the floor of the apartment, included many expensive watches.

The report said the haul was found as part of a police operation in which eight suspected Mafiosi were arrested on charges of criminal association and 15 warrants were issued to suspected Mafiosi already in jail on other charges.
Riina, once the undisputed head of the Mafia, was arrested in January 1993 after 23 years on the run.

Since his arrest, magistrates have confiscated numerous houses, apartments and tracts of land, mostly in Sicily, believed to have been owned by Riina but registered under names of family members or accomplices.
